sources.name: KeepTradeCut
sources.format: redraft 1QB (KTC fantasy rankings); no TE premium

sources.name: KeepTradeCut SF
sources.format: redraft superflex (KTC fantasy rankings); no TE premium

sources.name: Sleeper ADP
sources.format: half-PPR redraft ADP from the pool's Sleeper projections snapshot

sources.name: Sleeper 2QB ADP
sources.format: 2QB redraft ADP from the same snapshot

sources.name: Sleeper League Points
sources.format: league-scored projected points (0.5 PPR, +1.0/rec TE premium): the sort Sleeper's league players page shows

sources.name: Sleeper League VORP
sources.format: value over replacement on the league-scored projection with the opening lineup across 32 teams: an assistant reading the settings and projections through Sleeper's API

sources.name: Consensus Average
sources.format: mean provider rank across the other 13 sources

sources.name: Cold-Start Room Prior
sources.format: 50% Sleeper half-PPR ADP + 30% league VORP + 20% mean rank of the format-adjusted boards

method.unit: rank of the selected player among that provider's players still available
method.fit_score: 100 * 2 ** (-mean(log2(availability_rank)) / 3); higher is closer. A missing player receives the same loss as availability rank 32.
method.interpretation: The inferred source is the closest supplied board, not proof the drafter used it. Confidence measures only separation from the runner-up.
